verdicts.reason: A keeps the centred two-line headline in the same proportion as the original and sits it evenly in the landscape frame. It's quiet but true to the minimalist original; the only nit is that it sits a little high and the bottom margin is heavier. B pushes the text block hard to the left edge (about 30px gutter) and leaves the right ~40% as dead space. The 'silence.' line is centred under the first line while the block is left-placed, so it is neither centred nor flush-left and reads as accidental. The block also sits high with a big empty bottom.
